description.value: The Sandman Hotel Castlegar is a mid-size chain hotel on Columbia Avenue in Castlegar, part of the national Sandman Hotels group. Amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, free parking, and pet-friendly rooms, making it a comfortable layover for cyclists passing through the Kootenay region. The property has earned Bronze Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the hotel is open and operational with detailed room listings and amenity pages. Bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. Free Wi-Fi is confirmed by both the website ('Free Wi-Fi' listed throughout) and OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no); USB charging ports are confirmed by the individual room detail page; continental breakfast is listed as an available amenity on both the main page and room details page.
concerns: OSM email field contains 'reservations@hotelname.com', which appears to be a generic placeholder rather than a real contact address — should be verified or removed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with a fully functional website confirming rooms and amenities; useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Castlegar area.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Continental breakfast listed as an available amenity on the hotel amenities page and referenced in individual room descriptions

Device charging.detail: USB Charging Ports listed under Room Features on the Standard Room detail page

wow_evidence: part of the national Sandman Hotels group

price.label: Mid-range
